label: FP
reason: Both alerts are False Positives. Alert 1 (java/xss): The sink (encodeForHTML call) processes results from the database query, but the SQL query ('sql') is constructed using 'bar', which resolves to the constant 'moresafe' due to list manipulation in doSomething (param is dropped). Thus, user input does not reach the sink. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): The sink ('sql') resolves to a constant query string containing 'moresafe' instead of the user parameter 'param', verified by tracing the list removal/indexing logic in doSomething. Both sinks receive non-user-controlled values.

evidence.note: doSomething method filters param via list add/remove/get, resolving bar to constant 'moresafe' regardless of param content
SQL string constructed using bar (constant 'moresafe'), blocking user input injection
XSS sink encodes results from DB query (driven by constant 'moresafe'), not user input
